alpha_hypothesis.statement: Near-52-week-high Commodity trend entries may still be under-budgeted after the latest accepted stack; raising only the existing Commodity trend multiplier from 1.5x to 2.0x should lift EV without adding entries, filters, exits, or tickers.

similar_prior_results.exp-20260429-013: Accepted the original 1.5x trend_long Commodities near-high risk budget; broad/deeper Commodity boosts were already flagged as unsafe.
similar_prior_results.exp-20260505-013: Rejected a state-conditioned Commodity trend total-risk boost because it improved only the strongest window and missed Gate 4.
similar_prior_results.recent_ranking_and_event_families: LLM/event soft ranking, candidate ranking, broad universe expansion, and nearby add-on/cap variants are either data-limited or recently rejected.

history_guardrails.why_not_simple_repeat: This replay did not add a new Commodity selector or widen the near-high threshold. It tested only whether the already-accepted 1.5x sleeve still had unused sizing headroom under the current post-20260507 accepted stack.

market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where strategy profits but can lag indexes
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

gate4.basis: Fails Gate 4: aggregate EV improved only 1.19%, aggregate PnL improved only 0.67%, Sharpe improved only 0.02 in one window, drawdown/trade count/win rate did not materially improve, and only one of three windows changed.

decision_reason: The sleeve remains high quality, but the next multiplier step is mostly position-cap constrained. Extra size only moved late_strong by $1,110.16 and left mid_weak/old_thin unchanged, so the existing 1.5x policy is retained.

production_impact.promotion_path_if_accepted: Would have been a shared quant/constants.py value consumed by portfolio_engine.size_signals in both backtester and production run paths.

llm_metrics.blocker_relation: LLM soft-ranking remains data-limited; this run deliberately tested a deterministic, production-replayable allocation alpha instead.

mechanism_insight: The near-high Commodity trend sleeve is still a strong attribution bucket, but the next raw risk-budget increment is not the bottleneck under the current stack. More Commodity scalar tuning is unlikely to be useful without new cap-room or forward concentration evidence.
next_retry_requires: Do not retry nearby 1.75x, 2.0x, or 2.5x Commodity near-high risk multipliers from the same three snapshots.
A valid retry needs evidence that Commodity winners are specifically constrained by position cap or heat and that changing that capacity does not repeat rejected heat/add-on-cap families.
If Commodity alpha is revisited, prefer a new ex-ante event or macro discriminator rather than another scalar-only multiplier.
